hardware.flightController: Pixhawk 6C or the verified controller actually supplied with the used kit
hardware.companion: Jetson Orin Nano 8GB; not the legacy Jetson Nano
hardware.camera: Luxonis OAK-D S2, standard FOV, exact focus/sensor revision to record
hardware.power: Separate measured regulated supply for companion and USB3 camera; never assume a flight-controller peripheral rail can power them
hardware.mount: Rigid calibrated camera/IMU transforms, vibration isolation appropriate to each sensor, measured propeller and cable envelope

softwareBaseline.companionOS: JetPack 6.2 / Jetson Linux 36.4.3 / Ubuntu 22.04 arm64 compatibility baseline, not an installed image
softwareBaseline.ros: ROS 2 Humble (Ubuntu 22.04 arm64 Tier 1; support scheduled through May 2027)
softwareBaseline.depthDriver: luxonis/depthai-ros Humble branch; resolve and record exact tested commit on the bench
softwareBaseline.px4: Select stable release for the actual Pixhawk board and match px4_msgs definitions; no firmware was flashed
softwareBaseline.bridge: uXRCE-DDS telemetry bridge proposed, disabled in this project
softwareBaseline.mapping: RTAB-Map RGB-D odometry/map adapter already in project; a free-space raycasting 3D occupancy layer and covariance checks still required
softwareBaseline.gazebo: Use the Gazebo/PX4 version pairing in the selected PX4 release documentation; do not infer compatibility from ROS Humble default packages

logicalStreams.name: rgb
logicalStreams.requirements: Keep original image plus inference resize metadata; capture exposure, gain, focus and sequence ID

logicalStreams.name: aligned_depth
logicalStreams.requirements: Calibrated alignment, units and validity mask; invalid/zero depth remains unknown

logicalStreams.name: camera_info
logicalStreams.requirements: Intrinsics for the exact crop, scale, focus and resolution; do not use illustrative fx=1380

logicalStreams.name: stereo_left
logicalStreams.requirements: Synchronized raw evidence for depth failure diagnosis

logicalStreams.name: stereo_right
logicalStreams.requirements: Synchronized raw evidence for depth failure diagnosis

logicalStreams.name: odometry
logicalStreams.requirements: Metric local pose, covariance, reset counter and timestamp; source/quality validated under canopy

logicalStreams.name: imu
logicalStreams.requirements: Time-aligned sensor source and calibrated transforms; log actual OAK hardware IMU if present

frameContract.camera: optical x right, y down, z forward
frameContract.px4: NED/FRD conversions require a tested adapter; this code does not provide flight commands
